item.title: Reverse math shows why hard problems are hard
item.description:
📝 They change the axioms they start with, then explore how the changes affect which theorems they can prove. They used this approach, called reverse mathematics, to prove that many distinct theorems in complexity theory are actually exactly equivalent. Complexity theorists proved decades ago that the answer is no.

item.title: John Giannandrea to retire from Apple
item.description:
📝 Apple also announced that renowned AI researcher Amar Subramanya has joined Apple as vice president of AI, reporting to Craig Federighi. Subramanya will be leading critical areas, including Apple Foundation Models, ML research, and AI Safety and Evaluation. This team is currently responsible for Apple Foundation Models, Search and Knowledge, Machine Learning Research, and AI Infrastructure.
🔗 Read more: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/12/john-giannandrea-to-retire-from-apple/
